Do your knees cave inward when you squat, walk, or exercise? Learn why this happens and try eight targeted exercises to improve knee alignment, strengthen the muscles around your hips and legs, and help reduce knee pain.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
